Business rule: Every active record must have an assigned accountable owner
Business impact: Unowned records can't be serviced or reconciled

Business rule: Active customer records must have at least one valid contact method
Active contracts must reference a valid counterparty
A record's start date cannot be later than its end date
Required data elements: Record ID, Start date, End date

Business rule: Identifiers must match the organization's defined format
Amounts must not be negative unless tied to an approved reversal
Test or demo records must not carry real financial values
Every child record must have a valid parent record
Coded values must exist in the corresponding reference table
A record expected to have one organizational assignment must not have several
Active records must not have end dates in the past
Records must not carry attributes from mutually exclusive billing methods
Required data elements: Record ID, Billing method, Billing attributes

Business rule: Active records must not be duplicated on their business key
Required downstream processing must occur within the defined SLA
Required data elements: Record ID, Created date, Processed date

Business rule: Required financial values must be populated within the defined number of days
Required data elements: Record ID, Created date, Required value

Business rule: Values must fall within an approved range or threshold
Business impact: Signals data entry or calculation errors

Business rule: Variance between estimated and actual values must stay within an approved tolerance
Required data elements: Record ID, Estimated value, Actual value

Business rule: Aggregated values should stay within historical expectations
Business impact: Detects systemic data or processing issues

Business rule: Industry or product classification codes must be present and consistent with a trusted reference
Product-specific required fields must be populated as new products are onboarded
Required data elements: Record ID, Product type, Required fields
